phases.name: Send every Jira Cloud search in a request body, so a long key list can no longer be refused for the length of the request line
phases.description: Bug 6315. On Jira Cloud a delta download (or Feature download, parent-details fetch or keyed identity sweep) that lists 200 keys of 14 or more characters is answered 414 RequestUriTooLong, because Cloud search still carries its JQL in the query string. Every Cloud search goes through one walk, so moving that walk to POST rest/api/3/search/jql with a JSON body fixes every key-batched call site at once. Data Center already searches by POST and is unaffected.

steps.name: Ask Jira Cloud for issues over POST, so the query is no longer part of the request line
criteria: A Cloud download of a whole chunk of long keys (200 keys whose escaped JQL alone exceeds 8,192 bytes) sends a request whose URI is under 8,192 bytes, still asks Jira for every key including the last, and reads all 200 Work Items back
The same holds on Data Center, which already sends its query in a body, so one test pair pins both deployments
Every Cloud search is sent as a POST to the Cloud search route, with the JQL, the fields asked for, the page size and the changelog expansion in a JSON body
On Cloud the changelog expansion is sent as a single string and the fields as a list, so Work Item transitions are still read inline exactly as before
The first page carries no page token, and every later page carries the token Jira handed back in the body, so token paging walks the same pages as before
Searches that name their own fields (the identity sweeps and the Delivery release-membership walk) still ask for exactly those fields and no others
A refused Cloud search is still read from the response body and still reaches the same refusal type, so the refresh summary line still names the query and Jira's answer
Chunks of keys stay at 200 per query and keep their `key = "X" OR ...` form
Test helpers that read the Cloud query, fields or page size out of the URL read them from wherever the request carries them, and every existing Cloud test still passes

No comment in the touched code still says that Cloud search carries its query in the URL or that the chunk size guards a request-line length; no comment cites an internal document, ticket or ADR as its explanation
steps.implementation_notes:
Root cause A of docs/feature/fix-jira-414-key-batched-queries/rca.md (sections 1, 4, 5 and 6 are the spec). Maintainer decisions: Cloud search moves from GET with a query string to POST rest/api/3/search/jql with a JSON body; chunk size 200 and the key = "X" OR ... form stay; the write-back failures ('0 succeeded, 28 failed') and the permanent-lockout hardening (root cause B, fall back to the full download on a refused keyed download) are OUT OF SCOPE.

RED FIRST (both must fail on current code - confirm the failure before touching production):
  1. In JiraIncrementalSyncTest, beside GetWorkItemsForTeamByReferenceId_OnDataCenter_AsksForAQueryNoRequestLineCouldCarry (~:974), turn that test into a [TestCase(Cloud)] [TestCase(DataCenter)] pair named GetWorkItemsForTeamByReferenceId_AsksForAQueryNoRequestLineCouldCarry, using AJiraThatHasAlreadyBeenTalkedTo(deploymentType) and the existing JiraStub. Given 200 keys like LONGPROJECTKEY-{n:D9}; when GetWorkItemsForTeam(team, keys, ...); then inside one using (Assert.EnterMultipleScope()): positive control Uri.EscapeDataString(download.Value("jql")).Length > 8192; download.Uri.OriginalString.Length < 8192; download.Value("jql") contains the last key; 200 Work Items read back. The budget constant is currently named for Tomcat - rename or re-word it so it reads true for both deployments. On current code the Cloud case fails (URI is ~8.1 KB+ because the escaped JQL is in the query string); the Data Center case passes, which shows the test detects exactly the Cloud defect.
  2. Cloud-only companion GetWorkItemsForTeam_OnCloud_PostsTheSearchWithTheChangelogExpansionAsOneString. Extend SearchAsk with the request's HttpMethod (recorded in JiraStub.Respond). Assert: Method == HttpMethod.Post; the path ends with the Cloud search route (compare against JiraRestRoutes.For(JiraDeployment.Cloud).Search - reusing the route is the clearer test; note JiraRouteLiteralsTest scans only the production project, so the existing literal at JiraIncrementalSyncTest.cs:44 is legal, while the production rule stands: no rest/api/ literal in the connector); the body's expand is a JSON STRING "changelog" (check JsonValueKind.String - NOT an array: Data Center's ["changelog"] shape copied to Cloud would be ignored or refused and silently drop every transition); fields is a JSON array ["*all"] (JsonValueKind.Array); page 1 has no nextPageToken property.
  3. Extend the existing Cloud token-paging sweep test (~:345-360) so the second request carries nextPageToken IN THE BODY.
  BODY ASSERTIONS MUST NOT GO THROUGH SearchAsk.Value(): it reads the request line FIRST and only falls back to the body (JiraIncrementalSyncTest.cs:1137-1141), so on current code Value("nextPageToken") and Value("expand") are found in the GET URL and those assertions would pass. Every shape assertion in 2 and 3 (expand a JSON string, fields a JSON array, page 1 without nextPageToken, page 2 with nextPageToken) parses ask.Body with JsonDocument and checks the property and its ValueKind directly (TryGetProperty), with the body empty on current code. The crafter must run each new or extended assertion against the unchanged production code and record that it is RED there, assertion by assertion, before GREEN; an assertion that is green on current code proves nothing and must be rewritten.

GREEN: change only the Cloud search walk (the one place Cloud's JQL is put into a URL; it already serves the full download, delta download, Feature download, parent details, both sweeps, validation preview and Delivery release membership). Build the body as jql (string), fields (string[] - split the existing comma-joined Fields), expand ("changelog" or omitted), maxResults (int), nextPageToken (omitted on page 1). Post it with the existing AsJson helper to a static readonly CloudSearchPath taken from JiraRestRoutes.For(JiraDeployment.Cloud).Search. Response parsing, token paging, MaxCloudSearchPages, changelog completion and refusal reading are unchanged - Cloud's POST returns the same SearchAndReconcileResults schema as the GET.
  - CA1869 (4x recurrence): the serializer options with DefaultIgnoreCondition = JsonIgnoreCondition.WhenWritingNull live in ONE private static readonly JsonSerializerOptions field, never new'd per call. WhenWritingNull is what keeps nextPageToken and expand out of the body rather than sending null (a null first-page token is a known Cloud trouble spot).
  - S1192: "changelog" already appears as a literal (TheChangelogAsWell). Give Cloud's string a named const; do NOT reuse the Data Center array constant.
  - Fields must always be sent: Cloud POST defaults to id-only when fields is omitted.
  - Drop the StringBuilder / System.Text usings if nothing else uses them (an unused using is a Sonar issue).

TEST HELPERS that read the Cloud query from the URL break with certainty (test-only). Grep "jql=", ".Query", PathAndQuery and LastSearchUrl across Lighthouse.Backend.Tests and make each read the body when the URL has nothing - JiraIncrementalSyncTest.SearchAsk already does this and is the model:
  - TestHelpers/StubTransport.cs:64-85 RecordedRequests: FieldsAskedForInTheLastSearch parses fields from the URL (consumers JiraDependencyLinkTest.cs:288 and :310); after the fix it must read the fields list from the last search's body, comma-joined so callers keep comparing the same text. Record() adds a url only when RequestUri is non-null but always adds a body, so the two lists can misalign - do not pair them by index. Record one entry per request carrying its url and its body together, and take the last search's body from that same entry (Urls / Bodies / Paths stay available as projections for existing callers).
  - ParentPlacementAcceptanceTest.TheQueryIn (~:561-566) falls back to the raw JSON body, where key = \" is escaped, so KeyClause no longer matches - parse the body's jql string instead.
  - Slice02ParentFromLinkSpecifications.AJiraAnsweringForThatInstance (~:591-602) routes Cloud search answers by the URL query - pass the body's jql when the query is empty (not named in the RCA, found by grep).
  - JiraDeliverySourceProviderTest.QueryValue (~:1168-1174, read at ~:860 and ~:1424).
  - JiraBoardQueryAssemblyTest: two changes. The recorder in AHandlerWhereSearch (~:1101) keeps only RequestUri.PathAndQuery - it must also capture the request body. JqlOf (~:1013-1019) does .First(parameter => parameter.StartsWith("jql=")) on the url, which THROWS once Cloud's query string is empty - it must read the jql string from the captured body (falling back to the url only if a test still drives a GET).
  - JiraIssuesPerRequestTest.ThePageSizeAskedFor already falls back to the body; only its summary ('Cloud asks in the query string') is now wrong.
  A helper change must not weaken an assertion: if a test asserted something about the URL that now lives in the body, assert it on the body. NUnit2045: a helper with two Assert.That calls needs its own EnterMultipleScope. CA1859: new private helpers/locals take concrete types. CA1861: no inline new[] in assertions - hoist to static readonly. NUnit4002/NUnit2046: Is.Zero, Has.Count/Has.Length.

STALE COMMENTS (fix in the same change, plain-language why, no 'Bug 6315', 'RCA', 'ADR-xxx' or section refs as explanation):
  - JiraRestRoutes.cs:58-60 'Cloud's is read with a query string and paged by token' -> both take their parameters in a JSON body; Cloud is paged by token, Data Center by offset.
  - JiraWorkTrackingConnector.cs:53-59 (DataCenterSearchPath summary) - no longer the only body-shaped search; say the remaining shape differences (Data Center wants expand as a list, Cloud as one string).
  - JiraWorkTrackingConnector.cs:270-272, 340-341 and ~365-366 ('another OR clause in a URL that has to survive whatever proxy...') -> the chunk bounds how much one round trip asks for and returns; the query rides in the body on both deployments.
  - JiraIncrementalSyncTest.SearchAsk summary (~:1130-1134) and JiraIssuesPerRequestTest (~:42-45) both say Cloud uses the query string.
  S125: no prose comment line may end in ';'.

VERIFY (no live connector runs - the Linear key is shared with CI and the Jira Integration category talks to a real instance):
  dotnet test --filter "TestCategory!=Integration&TestCategory!=JiraIntegration&TestCategory!=LinearIntegration&TestCategory!=AdoIntegration&TestCategory!=ServiceNowIntegration"
  then, AFTER the last edit and before any push: cd Lighthouse.Backend && dotnet format analyzers Lighthouse.sln --severity info --verify-no-changes --no-restore, filtered to the touched files. In a worktree, 2 Licensing failures on the gitignored premium fixture are environmental.

RESIDUAL RISK (no code change, record for release notes): a custom granular-only scoped Cloud API token may lack the POST operation's beta scope; the documented classic read:jira-work scope covers both GET and POST. Stryker on the connector runs at feature finalization on frozen code (the Cloud walk already had survivors).

EXEMPT FROM PARADIGM: C# / NUnit project with no Hypothesis; the contract is a wire shape and a length bound pinned by single-example fixture tests (200 long keys, one paged walk). Compensate with the Cloud+Data Center TestCase pair, which quantifies the invariant over both deployments.

validation.note: Bugfix roadmap derived from docs/feature/fix-jira-414-key-batched-queries/rca.md, which the maintainer approved on 2026-10-16 as the stand-in for DISCUSS/DESIGN/DISTILL for this defect. Scope: root cause A (Cloud search transport). Root cause B (a refused keyed download locking a Team out permanently) and branch C (write-back '0 succeeded, 28 failed') are excluded and to be raised separately if the reporter's logs warrant it. The alternatives the RCA weighed - key in (...) and length-sized chunks - are not taken: both stay bound by an undocumented request-line limit that POST removes.
